title: How OpenAI scales PostgreSQL to 800 million users
summary:
The short version



OpenAI runs ChatGPT on a single PostgreSQL primary that takes every write, plus nearly 50 read replicas across regions, and serves 800 million users without sharding Postgres.
Keep load off the primary: send reads to replicas and move shardable, write-heavy workloads to a sharded database. OpenAI no longer adds new tables to its Postgres.

summary:

Not necessarily.
